claims.exact_statement: For every k>=1, every n, and arbitrary deterministic U,V:{0,1}^n->{0,1} on the uniform cube having the independent Bernoulli(2^-k) output law, f=(-1)^(UV) satisfies I(f)>=4k*2^(-2k). For the A077/B09 gain J_k=h2(r)-2^-k h2(s), r=4*2^(-2k)(1-2^-k), s=4*2^-k(1-2^-k), one has J_k/I(f)<=1+log2(e)/k. Hence correlated/shared-variable realization of this same gate law cannot produce an unbounded helper-to-physical-influence ratio.
hypotheses: Their joint output law is the independent Bernoulli(2^-k) law
Total influence uses the standard uniform-cube normalization
proof_dependencies: Known edge-isoperimetric inequality on the discrete cube
B16-A077-COMPENSATED-TOWER-v1 for the definition of J_k
scope_exclusions: Does not exclude a different gate or gain not localized on the rare joint cell
Does not claim universal conditional spectral entropy control
refutes: The proposed escape in which correlated encoders preserve the B09 gate law but make its physical influence o(k*2^(-2k))
claims.first_unproved_line: No barrier is proved for a different gate whose gain is not a function of a rare output cell.
